actor:live.label: in the system
actor:live.note: membership: read from the dated system membership inside the panel window; past it the universe stands as it is

actor:polyarchy.label: Electoral democracy index
actor:polyarchy.note: the engine moves it by ±0.1 on a regime step; between steps it is held

actor:intrastate.label: Internal armed conflict
actor:intrastate.note: the engine writes level 1 and never 2 (intrastate_onset has no intensity): level 2 forward is a carried as-of spell, not a forecast

actor:occupied.label: Occupied
actor:occupied.note: occupation is data, not a hazard: carried from as-of

actor:great_power.label: Major power (CoW)
actor:great_power.note: fitted entry/exit transitions on the moved capability share (src/engine/greatpower.js, C2)

actor:nuclear.label: Nuclear weapons
actor:nuclear.note: world.nukes at as-of, then the fitted acquisition hazard (src/engine/nuclear.js, C4); disarmament is not modelled

actor:cinc.label: Capability (CINC)
actor:cinc.note: moved by each actor's simulated total output growth and renormalised (C1, src/engine/core.js:stepCinc) — an assumption: CINC tracks output only loosely

actor:wave.label: Regional wave (opening odds x)
actor:wave.note: exp(sigma u - sigma^2/2) for the opening template, u the region-year shock (AR(1), seeded from the wave visible at as-of); 1 = a quiet year

actor:union.label: Union
actor:union.note: open vocabulary: the union id (eu) or none

dyad:at_war.label: Pair at war
dyad:at_war.note: truth: the merged dyadic war spells src/engine/termination.js:warSpells builds from data/events.json

dyad:allied.label: Defence pact
dyad:allied.note: the dated pact graph (scripts/lib/hist.mjs:loadPacts) at as-of, moved by fitted formation / dissolution hazards (src/engine/alliances.js, C3)

dyad:presence.label: Military presence
dyad:presence.note: a great-power station of either side on the other (data/presence.yaml at as-of, then fitted open / close hazards: src/engine/stations.js, C6); the key is the sorted pair, the patron is the great power

dyad:trade.label: Trade dependence
dyad:trade.note: min(s_ij, s_ji), s = the pair's trade over each side's total recorded trade; the series ends 2006-2009 and carries; a forecast holds the as-of value

dyad:holds.label: Holds territory
dyad:holds.note: CShapes 2.0 holders (data/holders.json); with C5 breakup a territory can leave its holder in a run

dyad:colony.label: Holds a dependency
dyad:colony.note: colony, protectorate, mandate or occupation (CShapes 2.0 status)

record:status.label: Status
record:status.note: open vocabulary: the status words of data/corridors.yaml and data/territories.yaml; control transfer is not simulated

templates.label: Regime category moves up (V-Dem RoW), autocracies at risk
Liberalisation from above — freedom of expression rises >= 0.05 in a year (autocracies)
Dyadic militarized dispute with use of force
An actor reaches sovereign production in a capability wave
Corridor status or control transition (advance, cut, or change of hands)
